(BOUNDARY TEST) UFS 4.1 HID (Host-Initiated Defragmentation) is idle-triggered in our BSP. The camera app is in foreground and recording 4K60 video while HID starts in background. We observe:

  Frame drop bursts ~every 200ms during first 30s of HID

Is it correct to run HID concurrently with an active video recording? What is the proper hid_enable gating policy vs camera-HAL state? Should the block layer I/O scheduler have an HID-aware priority policy? If HID must be interrupted mid-progress, what is the resumption contract?
